sql: select s.market_ticker, s.at, left(s.yes_levels_json::text,140) yes_lv, left(s.no_levels_json::text,140) no_lv, s.est_yes_score_total yt, s.est_no_score_total nt, s.est_yes_meets_target ym, s.est_no_meets_target nm, p.period_reward_usd pool, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.target_size, p.discount_factor_bps from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from incentive_market_snapshots where market_ticker in ('KXUSISMSERV-26NOV04-T55.8','KXGPTAPP-26NOV08-T50') order by market_ticker, at desc) s left join lateral (select * from incentive_programs ip where ip.market_ticker=s.market_ticker order by last_seen_at desc limit 1) p on true
